definitions.explanation: An error in printed or published text where a wrong character, letter, or word appears. Originally referred to errors in typesetting but now also covers digital text errors.

examples.japanese: {誤植|ごしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誤植|ごしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チェックした→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧。
examples.english: I carefully checked for typos before publication.

notes:
Composed of {誤|ご} (error, mistake) and {植|しょく} (plant, set type). The {植|しょく} refers to {植字|しょくじ} (typesetting), so the word literally means "error in typesetting." Despite its printing origins, it is commonly used for typos in any medium including digital text.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤植|ごしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to fix a typo
- {誤植|ごしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: many typos
- {誤植|ごしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧: to find a typo
- {誤植|ごしょく}⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧: full of typos

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧: wrong character — a broader term for any wrong character in writing, not limited to print
- ⟦{脱字|だつじ}→脱字：16583_datsuji⟧: omitted character — a missing character rather than a wrong one
- タイポ: typo — the English loanword, used casually in conversation and online
